#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center
#| label: fig-fully-connected-swig
#| fig-cap: "Fully connected SWIG"

make_swig("fully_connected")      |> 
  plot_swig(node_radius = 0.2, nudge_intervention_labels = 0.18) + 
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(option = "light") +
  scale_color_mpxnyc(option = "manual", values = c("covariate" = "black", "intervention" = "black")) +
  theme_mpxnyc_blank()
